notes:
I couldn't write the Isaiah 34 notes this time, because my research tools stopped working before I could read any of the sources.

**What happened:** I asked for six pages at once:
- Enduring Word on Isaiah 34
- Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Gill on Bible Hub
- Precept Austin's Isaiah 34 page
- the NET Bible notes

My script failed while reading the results, and the tool then told me I had no calls left for this turn. So I never read a single line from any of these sites.

**Why there are no notes:** Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. With nothing read, any notes I wrote would break that rule and couldn't honestly carry a URL.

**What I'd do next:** If you ask again, I'll start with the same verse-by-verse sources (Enduring Word, Ellicott, Pulpit, Gill, Precept Austin, NET Bible notes). Then I'll search the tradition-specific and Catholic/Orthodox sites for the debated passages:
- v. 4: the stars dissolving and the skies rolling up, and how this links to Revelation 6
- vv. 5–8: Edom as a type, and the "day of vengeance"
- v. 10: the smoke rising "forever"
- v. 16: "the scroll of the LORD" and "His Spirit"

Then I'll write the notes verse by verse, with a URL after each point. If it would help, I can also do the chapter in two parts (vv. 1–8, then vv. 9–17) so I'm less likely to run out of tool calls.
